featured.title: Nikunj Kothari · FPV Ventures 合伙人（种子/A 轮投资人）
featured.summaryEn: FPV Ventures partner Nikunj Kothari scraped the sub-processor lists of 803 companies to see what AI-native companies run on. Versus March: 44% now list two or more model providers (up from 33%), with Anthropic growing roughly twice as fast as OpenAI on a small n; 33% list an inference provider (up from 22%), with Modal still dominant; Chinese models show up mainly via video (e.g. ByteDance) rather than text; and TypeSafe AI is the breakout, going from zero to many companies quickly. Caveat: sub-processor lists lag…
featured.insightZh: Nikunj 抓取了 803 家公司的 sub-processor（数据子处理方）清单，看 AI 原生公司的基础设施到底在用什么。和 3 月那次对比：44% 的公司列出两家及以上模型供应商（此前 33%），样本虽小但 Anthropic 增速约为 OpenAI 的两倍；33% 的公司列出了推理服务商（此前 22%），Modal 持续领跑；中国模型主要通过视频（如字节跳动）而非文本进入这些清单；TypeSafe AI 是突围黑马，短期内从 0 走到很多家。他提醒 sub-processor 清单是滞后指标，但能确定公司真的在用。完整数据在 deploygraph 网站。另外他还转发了一位隐身期被投创始人的 RFS（创业方向征集）。

featured.title: Dan Shipper · Every CEO
featured.summaryEn: Dan Shipper says that in the cracks of one week he used AI to analyze a customer survey, build a team game, spot an opportunity to sell Every to teams, build a CRM and start outreach — work that once took five people and $200K. On OpenAI's GDPval, AI went from beating experts 12.4% of the time in 2024 to about 83% in 2026. But the aggregate misses something: with the same survey and same models, each teammate found something different. Generation is cheap; knowing what matters is hard — Claude, given 400 attempts,…
featured.insightZh: Dan Shipper 说他用 AI 在一周的碎片时间里分析了客户调研、给团队做了个游戏、发现了向团队销售 Every 的机会、自建 CRM 并开始外联——放在过去要 5 个人、20 万美元。OpenAI 的 GDPval 上，AI 胜过人类专家的比例从 2024 年的 12.4% 升到 2026 年约 83%。但他认为这种「总体视角」漏掉了关键：同一份调研、同一批模型，团队里每个人看出的东西完全不同；生成很便宜，判断哪个重要才难——Claude 给 400 个答案时 93% 能命中他在 Slack 里会说的话，但让它自己排序，他的答案只有约 60% 进入前 10%。他主张 AI 的衡量方式要变：不只问模型在公认问题上表现如何，而是问「它从我的视角做我的工作做得多好」。

featured.title: A New Vision for Human Work After Automation
featured.summaryEn: When everyone has the same model, the default answer becomes the baseline; the scarce value is using your own perspective and responsibility to push the model beyond it. This episode is Every CEO Dan Shipper's closing talk at Every's first conference, Thesis, on what great human work looks like after automation. He contrasts two ways to predict the future: the aggregate (extrapolating trend lines, like scaling laws or OpenAI's GDPval, where AI beat human experts 12.4% of the time in 2024, 47.6% in 2025 and about 83% in 2026) and the intimate (zooming into one real case). In aggregate terms, he did the work of five people in the cracks of one week with AI — which creates what he calls an "agency rupture." Zooming in tells a different story. Given the same customer survey and models, Dan saw a teams sales opportunity; growth engineer Yash found first-month churn from too much email and sh…
featured.insightZh: 当所有人都能用上同一个模型，默认答案就变成了底线；真正稀缺的价值，是你用自己的视角和责任把模型推到默认答案之外。 这一期是 Every CEO Dan Shipper 在 Every 首届大会 Thesis 上的闭幕演讲，主题是「自动化之后，伟大的人类工作是什么样」。他提出预测未来有两种方法：「总体」（大量数据外推趋势线，如 scaling law、OpenAI 的 GDPval——AI 胜过人类专家的比例从 2024 年 12.4%、2025 年 47.6% 升到 2026 年约 83%）和「亲密」（深入一个真实案例再外推）。从总体看，他一周碎片时间里用 AI 完成了数据科学家、游戏开发、产品营销、工程师、BDR 五个人的工作，看起来人类「完蛋了」，并造成一种「能动性断裂」。 但从「亲密」视角看：同一份客户调研交给团队，Dan 看到向团队销售的机会，增长工程师 Yash 发现首月订阅者因邮件过多而流失并直接提了 PR，市场负责人 Douglas 发现读者「很孤独」——身边人觉得他们痴迷 AI 很怪，编辑 Jack 则做了个黏土动画问答游戏。而 Claude 的默认分析虽然正确，但人人都能拿到，因此廉价。Every 的评测负责人 Mike Taylor 做过实验：Claude 生成 400 个答案时 93% 能命中 Dan 在 Slack 会说的话，但排序时只有约 60% 进前 10%——生成便宜，排序难。每个人对特定领域的责任缩小了搜索范围，个人视角决定了排序与取舍。 对于「明年模型就会排序了」的反驳，他认为比较对象本身是错的：不该比 2026 年的 Yash 和 2027 年的 Claude，而是 2027 年用着 2027 Claude 的 Yash，对比 2027 Claude 的默认提示——两边的 Claude 可以「约掉」。他由此回到自己 2024 年提出的「分配经济」：未来你被评判的是如何分配和管理智能资源。推论是 AI 的衡量方式要翻转——不只测公认可验证的问题，而要测「它从我的视角做我的工作有多好」。

items.title: Aditya Agarwal · South Park Commons 普通合伙人、前 Dropbox CTO
items.summaryEn: Aditya Agarwal sees two kinds of companies worth building now. First, "diffusion of AI" — today's vertical SaaS (FDE companies, rollups, horizontal products), all about getting AI close to where work happens, e.g. Profound, Cognition, Harvey. Second, "frontier of AI" — using AI to accelerate science and building products on that progress; SPC examples include Externa (new chemical building blocks for proteins), Epana Bio (genomics + AI for autoimmune therapies), VenomicsAI (venom-based drug discovery) and Equivari…
items.insightZh: Aditya 认为现在只有两类公司值得做：一是「AI 扩散」，相当于今天的垂直 SaaS（FDE 模式、roll-up、横向产品），核心都是把 AI 送到离实际工作最近的地方，代表如 Profound、Cognition、Harvey；二是「AI 前沿」，用 AI 加速科学进展再基于此做产品，SPC 里有 Externa（为蛋白质添加数百种新化学构件）、Epana Bio（基因组学+AI 设计自身免疫疗法）、VenomicsAI（毒液来源的 AI 药物发现）、Equivariant（半导体多物理场建模）。他认为第二类外界讨论不多，但大部分模型驱动的回报会来自这里。他还称赞了 Rox 及其创始人在「AI 速度」下经营公司的经验。

items.title: Google Labs · Google AI 实验产品平台
items.summaryEn: Google Labs launched Tabletop, a new experiment for getting groups from "we should do that" to "we're doing this." Drop links and files into a shared space, add your crew, and ask Tabletop to generate custom spaces on the fly — interactive road-trip maps, dinner-decider wheels, live pickleball brackets, merch voting boards, drag-and-drop seating charts. Founding engineer Roman Nurik showed family uses like chore charts, piggy banks, scavenger hunts, LEGO maps and a fantasy-themed NYC trip. Waitlist is open (US, 18…
items.insightZh: Google Labs 推出新实验 Tabletop：把链接和文件丢进一个共享空间、拉上朋友，再让 Tabletop 即时生成定制化空间，比如互动公路旅行地图、晚餐决策转盘、实时匹克球对阵表、周边投票板、拖拽式座位表，目标是让一群人从「应该去做」变成「真的在做」。创始工程师 Roman Nurik 还展示了家庭用法：互动家务表和存钱罐、雨天寻宝游戏、乐高地图、奇幻小说主题纽约行程。目前开放候补（仅美国、18 岁以上）。

items.title: Guillermo Rauch · Vercel CEO
items.summaryEn: Rauch's PSA: wonderful products still demand extraordinary human focus, effort, motivation, love — and an attention span. He also noted a benchmark pitting fx's bootup against an ultra-optimized pure-assembly fx.s, and promoted Reflection's Beam as free on Vercel until Nov 12: American open weights, zero data retention.
items.insightZh: Rauch 提醒：做出好产品依然需要极大量的人类专注、努力、动力和热爱，以及注意力。他还提到 Vercel 有个基准测试，让 fx 的启动速度去和纯汇编超优化版本 fx.s 对比；并宣传 Reflection 的 Beam 模型在 Vercel 上免费到 11 月 12 日——美国开源权重、零数据留存。

items.title: Thariq · 前 Anthropic Claude Code 团队
items.summaryEn: Thariq is giving the closing keynote at AIE Code, titled "the sweet side of the bitter lesson" — about what using coding agents could feel like next year and how we get to shape that experience.
items.insightZh: Thariq 将在 AI Engineer Code 大会做闭幕主题演讲，题为「苦涩教训的甜蜜一面」（the sweet side of the bitter lesson），内容是他设想明年使用编码 Agent 的体验会是什么样，以及我们如何去塑造它。

items.title: Claude · Anthropic 官方账号
items.summaryEn: Artist Mariko Mori, who has pushed the boundaries of art for three decades, used Claude to write code for a computer-generated animation presented as a new video installation in her retrospective "All That Shines."
items.insightZh: 艺术家 Mariko Mori 在其回顾展「All That Shines」中，用 Claude 编写了一段计算机生成动画的代码，作为新的影像装置作品展出。

items.title: Garry Tan · Y Combinator 总裁兼 CEO
items.summaryEn: On the Jensen Huang controversy, Garry Tan argued it would be ill-advised for NVIDIA's board to oust him, given how central his leadership is to the company's operations; he doubts a transition could happen without a massive market-cap implosion.
items.insightZh: 围绕 Jensen Huang 的风波，Garry Tan 认为 NVIDIA 董事会若撤换黄仁勋并不明智：他的领导对这家「未来富足引擎」的运营至关重要，很难相信换帅不会带来市值的大幅崩塌。

items.title: Amjad Masad · Replit CEO
items.summaryEn: Amjad questioned why old, not-well-hidden stories suddenly became international, geopolitical news. Calling the timing suspicious, he asked who benefits: if Jensen, the premier champion of open models, is taken out, those who want AI closed, centralized and controlled could gain — with the midterms and upcoming IPOs as possible factors.
items.insightZh: Amjad 对同一事件提出质疑：一些并未被认真掩盖的旧事为何突然成了国际和地缘政治新闻？他认为时机可疑，值得问「谁受益、为何是现在」——如果开源模型最大的拥护者 Jensen 被拉下马，想让 AI 封闭、集中、受控的一方可能受益；他还提到中期选举和即将到来的 IPO 可能相关。

items.title: Peter Yang · Roblox 产品负责人、AI 教程创作者
items.summaryEn: Peter Yang said he was deeply disappointed in Jensen, whose dishwasher-to-CEO story many, including himself, looked up to. He later clarified that finding the conduct appalling is different from firing him over it: the board should run a proper investigation and involve shareholders before acting, and there's no denying Jensen built a generational company.
items.insightZh: Peter Yang 对 Jensen 事件表示非常失望，称很多人包括他自己都曾以其从洗碗工到全球市值最高公司 CEO 的故事为榜样。但他随后补充：个人行为令人不齿，不等于应该因此被解雇；董事会采取行动前应做充分调查并让股东参与决定，Jensen 打造了一家划时代公司这一点无可否认。
